observation_packet.expected: refresh updates or retains the 40 cached posts without blanking the timeline
observation_packet.actual: UI showed no timeline while cache IPC still returned 40; a later successful refresh displayed 20 and shrank SQLite from 40 to 20
observation_packet.network_ws: first reported live response unavailable; repeat real refresh returned one 20-post page
